headline: As of 2026-11-03: 60,862,309 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 60,862,309 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,852,199), Florida (6,491,865), California (6,481,962).
